component.description: Single 20-bit, unbuffered voltage-output digital-to-analog converter with +/-1 LSB INL (B grade). sub_type: r2r. Segmented R-2R architecture: the 6 MSBs decode 63 matched resistors (switches E0-E62 select VREFP or VREFN) and the 14 LSBs drive a voltage-mode 14-bit R-2R ladder. Bipolar output: the span is set by a positive reference VREFP (5 V to VDD-2.5 V) and a negative reference VREFN (VSS+2.5 V to 0 V), giving an ideal transfer VOUT = (VREFP - VREFN) x D/(2^20 - 1) + VREFN, so a +/-10 V reference pair produces a +/-10 V bipolar output. Guaranteed monotonic (+/-1 LSB DNL). The reference inputs are force/sense (VREFPF/VREFPS, VREFNF/VREFNS) and require external unity-gain buffers; the DAC output is unbuffered with a 3.4 kohm output impedance and is normally driven through an external precision op amp using the on-chip RFB/INV feedback resistors. 3-wire SPI/QSPI/MICROWIRE serial interface up to 35 MHz, 1.8 V-compatible digital I/O. Wide bipolar supply up to +/-16.5 V. Pinout (20-lead TSSOP): 1 INV, 2 VOUT, 3 VREFPS, 4 VREFPF, 5 VDD, 6 RESET, 7 CLR, 8 LDAC, 9 VCC, 10 IOVCC, 11 SDO, 12 SDIN, 13 SCLK, 14 SYNC, 15 DGND, 16 VREFNF, 17 VREFNS, 18 VSS, 19 AGND, 20 RFB.

notes: sub_type: r2r. The AD5791 is a segmented voltage-mode DAC: the 6 MSBs decode 63 matched resistors (each switched to VREFP or VREFN) and the 14 LSBs drive a 14-bit R-2R ladder. component.polarity is bipolar because the output span runs VREFN to VREFP (e.g. -10 V to +10 V).

B grade (AD5791BRUZ). INL/DNL/offset/full-scale are printed in LSB in the datasheet; per the DAC dictionary LSB is not a legal unit. Linearity (INL, DNL, gain error) normalize to ppm of FSR and offset/full-scale to volts, with the printed LSB figure preserved in conditionsVerbatim. Conversion factor: 1 LSB = 1e6/2^20 = 0.9537 ppm of FSR; in volts, 1 LSB = span/2^20 (for the +/-10 V span, 20 V/2^20 = 1.907e-5 V).

glitch_impulse and digital_feedthrough carry the printed nV-sec figure in volt-seconds (Vs): 3.1 nV-sec = 3.1e-9 Vs. Midscale glitch impulse is swept over the reference span (V_REF): 3.1e-9 (+/-10 V), 1.7e-9 (10 V), 1.4e-9 (5 V) Vs.
gain_error is stored in ppm (an altUnit) because the AD5791 specifies it natively as ppm of FSR (+/-0.3 ppm typ, +/-6 ppm max at the +/-10 V span), not in LSB.

offset_error carries the datasheet's Zero-Scale Error (ideal zero-scale output = VREFNS), and full_scale_error carries the Full-Scale Error (ideal = VREFPS - 1 LSB); the DAC dictionary aliases zero-scale error onto offset_error. The zero-scale error temperature coefficient maps to offset_error_drift (ppm/degC altUnit). There is no full-scale-error drift key in the dictionary, so the +/-0.02 ppm FSR/degC full-scale TC is preserved in the full_scale_error conditionsVerbatim rather than dropped.

V_REF conditions are note-only because the AD5791 reference is a VREFP/VREFN pair (a span), not a single voltage; a numeric V_* condition would be dimension-checked against volts and could not express the pair.

reference_input_resistance holds the datasheet's code-dependent DC input impedance (5 kohm min / 6.6 kohm typ at midscale). supply_voltage arrays the three analog/digital rails (VDD, VSS, VCC) over V_SUPPLY; the digital interface rail IOVCC is the separate io_supply_voltage key. supply_current arrays IDD/ISS/ICC.
